description: A batched one-sided Jacobi eigensolver over the FULL n=512 matrix for the dense n=512 shapes (3 dense512, and as an alternative path for 11), expressed as batched tensor-core GEMM rotation sweeps rather than the current sign-DC-then-reduced-block pipeline. One-sided Jacobi on the symmetric matrix orthogonalizes columns via Givens/block rotations applied as batched GEMMs (high arithmetic intensity, no tridiagonalization, no cross-CTA cl.sync); the eigenvalues are the converged column norms and eigenvectors the accumulated rotations. Distinct from the sibling's reduced-block block-Jacobi (that was the n~300 leaf inside sign-DC; this replaces the whole n=512 solve). Targets compute-throughput via tensor cores on a gapless dense spectrum where sign-DC pays projector+CQR2+reduced-eigh; keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

Trial 1: profile baseline. Parent 029fa3b8 geomean 27371.664us. Shape 3 dense512 b640 = 74304us (routes low-rank k=352, mega_eigh_med_split_k 25.9ms + trsm CQR2 12.5ms). Shape 11 lapdense_even512 b640 = 76270us (sign-DC; stage sum 71ms: mega_eigh 28.9 + proj_cqr 18.6 + ns_sign 9.2 = target 56.7ms to beat; finish_ns 6.7; gate margin orth 5e-5 vs 5.49e-3, eigr 0.0037 vs 0.0107, 0/640 fallback). Confirms which solver each routes to.

Trial 2: first working block-Jacobi (full-n 3xTF32 GEMM, p=128 nb=4, 6 sweeps). Fixed convergence (sort pivot cols ascending -- descending round-robin pairs stall the cyclic map), restored _eigh_sign_dc_large return (was consumed by insertion), added finishing NS on V (orth drift fix). Shape 11 gate CLEAN 0/640 fallback but 586200us = 7.7x SLOWER than sign-DC 76270us; geomean 32066.

Trial 3: block size sweep p=64 (nb=8, 2p=128 pivots, 10 sweeps). WORSE: shape11=2600396us (2.6s) -- 7 rounds x 10 sweeps = 70 pivot-eigh calls; smaller pivots cheaper each but round-count explosion dominates. eigr 0.044 (3/640 fallback, 10 sweeps of 3xTF32 accumulate error). geomean 35911. p=128 confirmed better. (edit reverted, code = trial-4 commit.)

Trial 4: p=128, min sweeps (2-3) to minimize pivot-eigh calls. Shape 11 = 302524us (3 sweeps, ~100ms/sweep), gate CLEAN (orth 1e-5, eigr 0.0074 < 0.0107, 0/640 fallback). geomean 30460 vs parent 27371. Still ~4x slower than sign-DC. nsys: pivot mega_eigh_med_split_k 52% (the eigendecomposition per round dominates); ~9 reduced-eigh calls vs sign-DC's 1. Next: block-structured apply + TF32.

Trial 5: block-structured rotation apply (only 2p paired rows/cols, no full-n J build). Shape 11 = 331629us, UNCHANGED vs full-J 302524us (slightly worse from gather/scatter). Gate identical 0/640. geomean 30677. CONFIRMS profile: rotation-apply GEMM is NOT the bottleneck; pivot-eigh (52%, ~9 reduced-eigh calls x 17ms) is the wall. Block-Jacobi structurally needs many reduced-eigh where sign-DC needs 1.

Trial 6: route shape 3 to Jacobi + pivot bt_prec=tf32 + MIN_SWEEPS=3. Shape 3 Jacobi = 320917us vs low-rank 74304us (4.3x slower; concentrated spectrum converges to off-diag 1.1e-3 at 3 sweeps, gate clean). Shape 11 bt=tf32 = 321849us (pivot back-transform precision does not move mega_eigh cost). SWEEP-FLOOR measured: shape 11 needs 3 sweeps to clear eigr gate (1-2 sweeps -> 640/640 fallback); all-or-nothing knee. geomean 38424 (both target shapes regress 4x).

Trial 7 (final): no-regress state, both Jacobi routing switches OFF (measured routes 4x slower). Full block-Jacobi + measurement infra kept committed. VERIFIED 39/39 PASS, 'stream' absent, geomean 27379.7us == parent 27371.664 within noise (shape 3 74259us, shape 11 75650us -- no regression). nsys confirms shape 11 back on sign-DC (mega_eigh_med_split_k 33.5% + trsm 12.7%, matches parent). Brief conclusion: full-n block-Jacobi correct+gate-clean (0/640 fallback) but 4x slower; per-round 256x256 pivot-eigh (47-52%, 9x16.8ms=151ms at 3-sweep floor) exceeds each incumbent's whole ~75ms -- Jacobi needs >=9 reduced-eigh where sign-DC needs 1.

Built + measured the batched two-sided block-Jacobi over the FULL n=512 matrix on both dense n=512 shapes. It is CORRECT and gate-clean (0/640 fallback both shapes: orth ~1e-5 vs gate 5.49e-3, eigr ~0.0074-0.009 vs 0.0107) but ~4x SLOWER than the incumbents, so trial-7 final leaves routing OFF (geomean 27379.7us == parent 27371.664 within noise, 39/39 PASS, 'stream' absent).

PER-SHAPE (parent = the cost to beat): shape 11 lapdense_even512 Jacobi 302524us vs sign-DC 76270us; shape 3 dense512 cond2 Jacobi 320917us vs low-rank k=352 74304us. NOTE: shape 3 routes to LOW-RANK k=352 (not sign-DC as the brief framed); its incumbent nsys is mega_eigh_med_split_k 25.9ms + CQR2-trsm 12.5ms.

ROOT CAUSE (nsys trial-2/trial-5): the per-round 256x256 pivot EIGENDECOMPOSITION dominates at 47-52% -- mega_eigh_med_split_k, 9 calls x 16.8ms = 151ms at the 3-sweep floor, which ALONE exceeds each incumbent's whole ~75ms. The rotation-apply GEMMs (3xTF32, block-structured OR full-n) are only ~15-25% and NOT the bottleneck (block-structuring the apply left the wall UNCHANGED, 302->332us). So the brief's sweep-count x per-sweep-GEMM cost model missed the real cost: computing each block rotation needs a full pivot eigh, not just a GEMM. Full-n block-Jacobi replaces sign-DC's ONE reduced-eigh with >=9 same-size-class reduced-eighs -> structurally more expensive on a dense n=512 spectrum.

SWEEP-TO-GATE DATA: p=128 (nb=4) needs 3 sweeps (9 rounds) to clear shape 11's eigr gate -- an all-or-nothing knee: 1 sweep eigr 0.33 & 2 sweeps eigr 0.020 both -> 640/640 fallback (wall WORSE than baseline from the wasted Jacobi + full cuSOLVER redo); 3 sweeps eigr 0.0074 -> 0/640. 3xTF32 floors the off-diag ratio at ~2.3e-3 (shape 11) / 1.1e-3 (shape 3, concentrated) by sweep 4 -- cannot diagonalize further. A finishing 3xTF32 Newton-Schulz on V is REQUIRED (accumulating V<-VJ over sweeps drifts orth to 0.15 by sweep 12; 2 NS steps restore 1e-5). FP64 reference converges in 7 sweeps (p=128) / 9 (p=64) but 3xTF32 caps it. Block-size sweep: p=128 (302us) beat p=64 (2600us, 7 rounds x 10 sweeps = 70 pivot-eigh) decisively -- smaller pivots are cheaper each but the round-count explosion dominates.

OPEN DIRECTIONS I did NOT reach (the pivot-eigh is the ONLY lever that matters, since it is 50% and irreducible in block form):
1. PLANE (2x2 Hestenes) one-sided Jacobi instead of BLOCK: computes each rotation from a 2x2 Gram in closed form -- NO pivot eigh at all. But it needs ~130k plane rotations/sweep, which is only GPU-efficient as a CUSTOM KERNEL doing a whole round's disjoint rotations in parallel (a big kernel effort; batched-torch tiny ops would be far worse). This is the one formulation that structurally attacks the bottleneck.
2. Cheaper pivot solve exploiting that pivots are NEAR-DIAGONAL after sweep 1 (a refinement eigh / few inner 2x2 sub-sweeps instead of a full 256x256 mega_eigh each round). bt_prec=tf32 on the pivot back-transform did NOT help (pivot cost is tridiag/solve-bound, not back-transform).
3. A HYBRID: 1 Jacobi sweep as a cheap PRECONDITIONER to concentrate the spectrum, then hand to the low-rank/sign-DC path -- unmeasured.

I did not fully exhaust: plain-TF32 apply + finishing NS (apply is <25% so bounded upside), nb=2 single-512-pivot (that IS the whole problem, no benefit). The block-Jacobi code + all knobs (_JACOBI_*) + both routing switches are committed under adf76cf8d; flip _JACOBI_ROUTE_SIGNDC / _JACOBI_ROUTE_DENSE512 to re-measure. Recommend the manager weigh whether the plane-rotation custom-kernel Jacobi (direction 1) is worth a fresh brief, since block-Jacobi's pivot-eigh floor structurally cannot beat the single-reduced-eigh incumbents on these dense spectra.

Trial 8: HESTENES two-sided PLANE Jacobi (no pivot-eigh), shape 11. Removes the 52% block-pivot-eigh wall via closed-form 2x2 rotations. BUT shape 11 = 18875406us (18.9s, 247x SLOWER than sign-DC 76270us); geomean 41826. Hits BOTH walls the coordinator flagged: (1) LAUNCH SERIALIZATION -- n-1=511 rounds/sweep x ~6 elementwise ops each, sequential dependency = ~24500 launches at 8 sweeps (4.75s/sweep), never touches tensor cores; (2) SLOW CONVERGENCE on gapless even spectrum -- offdiag 0.65->0.55 over sweeps 4-8 (linear, not quadratic), 640/640 fallback (eigr 0.61>>0.0107). Sorted pairs required (unsorted stalls). Removing pivot-eigh trades a 52% eigh wall for a bigger launch+convergence wall; pure-PyTorch cannot do the 511 sequential round-launches/sweep -- needs a custom SMEM-resident sweep kernel (but n=512 A = 1MB > 228KB SMEM cap).

Trial 9 (final): no-regress, both Jacobi routing switches OFF. Block + plane Jacobi implementations + all knobs kept committed. Jacobi's iterative re-diagonalization mismatched vs sign-DC's single reduced-eigh.

Both implementations (_JACOBI_MODE = block | plane) + all knobs kept committed for a follow-up.

=== BLOCK Jacobi (256x256-pivot eigh per round), trials 2-7 ===
~4x slower: shape 11 302524us vs sign-DC 76270us; shape 3 320917us vs low-rank k=352 74304us. Gate-clean where it converges (0/640 fallback, orth 1e-5, eigr 0.0074). nsys: the per-round 256x256 pivot EIGENDECOMPOSITION (mega_eigh_med_split_k, 47-52%, >=9 calls x 16.8ms = >=151ms at the 3-sweep gate floor) ALONE exceeds each incumbent's ~75ms. Block-structuring the rotation-apply left the wall unchanged (apply is only 15-25%). Sweep-floor: shape 11 needs exactly 3 sweeps to clear the eigr gate (1-2 sweeps -> 640/640 fallback, all-or-nothing knee). p=128 (302us) beat p=64 (2600us, round-count explosion).

=== PLANE / HESTENES Jacobi (closed-form 2x2 rotations, NO pivot eigh), trial 8 ===
~247x slower: shape 11 = 18875406us (18.9s). Removing the pivot-eigh (the block wall) trades it for a BIGGER wall on BOTH axes you flagged: (1) LAUNCH SERIALIZATION -- plane Jacobi needs n-1=511 ROUNDS per sweep (n/2 disjoint 2x2 pairs/round), each round ~6 elementwise column/row combinations with a sequential dependency = ~24500 kernel launches at 8 sweeps, ~4.75s/sweep, NEVER touches tensor cores (the rotation-apply is memory-bound elementwise, not GEMM); (2) SLOW CONVERGENCE on the gapless even spectrum -- offdiag drops LINEARLY ~4%/sweep (0.65->0.55 over sweeps 4-8), not the quadratic drop a random matrix shows, so 4-8 sweeps leaves 640/640 over the eigr gate (0.61 >> 0.0107). FP64 prototype needs ~24 sweeps for a random matrix; the gapless near-degenerate spectrum is Jacobi's worst case. Pairs MUST be sorted ascending per round (unsorted round-robin STALLS at offdiag 0.54 -- the atan2 a_ii-a_jj sign flips; verified).

=== VERDICT (maps whether removing the pivot-eigh is enough) ===
Removing the pivot-eigh is NOT enough: block-Jacobi's wall was the per-round eigh (52%), and the plane version that eliminates it hits a bigger launch+convergence wall. Jacobi's ITERATIVE re-diagonalization is fundamentally mismatched to this batched dense-gapless n=512 problem vs sign-DC's SINGLE spectral-projector reduced-eigh (28.9ms) -- sign-DC does the whole solve in one non-iterative pass, which neither Jacobi flavor can match.

=== OPEN DIRECTIONS (unbuilt) ===
1. CUSTOM SMEM-resident sweep kernel for plane Jacobi (one CTA/matrix, whole sweep without per-round relaunch) -- the ONLY way to kill the 511-round launch wall. BUT n=512 A = 1MB > the 228KB SMEM cap, so A must stay in global memory with block-level (or cluster) sync per round -- a large kernel effort, and the gapless-spectrum slow convergence (>>24 sweeps) remains an independent wall.
2. HYBRID block-plane: wide panels (p=128, nb-1=3 rounds/sweep) but orthogonalize each 256-pivot with a few INNER plane rotations instead of a full eigh -- cuts the eigh cost while keeping round count low. Unmeasured; still has the inner-sweep launch issue at smaller scale.
3. A single Jacobi sweep as a cheap PRECONDITIONER before handing to sign-DC/low-rank -- unmeasured.
Given both flavors lose by 4-247x and the walls are structural (pivot-eigh count / launch serialization / gapless convergence / SMEM cap), I'd weight a fresh brief toward a NON-Jacobi angle for these dense n=512 shapes (or optimizing the sign-DC pipeline's mega_eigh + proj_cqr directly) over further Jacobi work. Both Jacobi implementations are committed under a7b2a53d (flip _JACOBI_ROUTE_* + _JACOBI_MODE to re-measure). Profiles: brief-104-trial-{1,2,5,9}-shape{3,11}-*.nsys-{rep,txt}.
